get_template_by_name: get a registered chat template by model type name like qwen2_vl or mllama
get_template_from_json: get a chat template by loading a custom JSON template file path
load_template_from_file: load and register a new chat template from a JSON configuration file
register_template: register a new chat template with custom format strings and processor into the registry
encode_sources_with_template: encode a list of role-content sources into a formatted string using a template
